error.access_denied: Pronote refused the access, all user sessions may be busy: try again later
error.account_locked: Too many authentication errors, Pronote locks this account for a while: try again in 15 minutes
error.invalid_qr_code: No Pronote QR code found, paste the JSON or send a clear picture of the QR code
error.ip_blocked: Pronote temporarily blocked this IP address after too many attempts: try again in a few hours
error.ip_suspended: Pronote returned an unexpected page: the IP may be blocked after too many attempts (try again in a few hours), or the ENT login changed
error.maintenance: Pronote is under maintenance (work in progress on the database): try again later
error.pronote_error: Pronote returned a technical error: try again later
error.proxy_refused: Pronote refuses connections from a public proxy, turn off the VPN or proxy
error.session_expired: The Pronote session expired: try again
error.site_unavailable: The Pronote site is currently unavailable: try again later
error.space_not_published: This Pronote space is not enabled by the school, check the account type
